notes: (1) Literature check (strict, cutoff 2025-09-24) could not run: related_search.py search failed twice with arXiv HTTP 429, so Phase 1.5 fell back to off; references are knowledge-based with [verify]; no ledger, similarity or novelty output. The skill says to fall back but does not say how many retries to try, or how to handle a rate limit rather than no network. (2) The task rules say to run only the aggregation script and related_search.py, while SKILL.md Phase 0 also requires integrity_scan.py; I ran it (clean, local, no network). (3) The skill orders Phase 1.5 after the reports but the search tool only needs the paper and fingerprint; I ran the fingerprint and search before writing the reports, which could affect independence if search had worked. (4) The pool-position guidance says an Overall 4 needs a pool position of 65 or more, which forces R3 to be placed in a band that only a lenient reviewer would choose; fine, but it is one more rule to track. (5) Reviewer passes share one context, so independence is partial; the skill allows this but the reports still tend to converge on the same issues (5 of 5 reviewers raised the attribution issue). (6) Sources of ambiguity: whether a missing causal control is MAJOR or a CRITICAL 'experiment cannot test the claim' (I followed 'missing control is MAJOR'); the Phase 1.6 table is a record of changes to drafts that are never shown, so it is only an honest summary rather than an auditable diff; the ICLR venue label printed by the script for Overall 3 is '4 on {0,2,4,6,8,10} (5 on {1,3,5,6,8,10})', two scales in one string. (7) Bash compound commands (cd && ..., mkdir) were blocked by the permission layer, so scripts were run with absolute paths and output folders were created by the Write tool.
